item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We must prevent that loss of control—not wait for it and call the aftermath regulation.

2. We cannot treat superintelligent AI as just another technology to regulate after launch. If it is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control its actions. We demand prevention before deployment.

3. We reject the promise that governments can build superintelligent AI first and establish control later. If it arrives within the next 20 years, that control will be beyond their reach. We must act before the choice is no longer ours.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. We cannot afford to confuse the power to approve a technology with the power to govern it once it exists. Laws, oversight bodies and emergency plans do not make an uncontrollable system controllable. We reject a race that puts public safety behind the ambition to build first. Our task is to demand government action before that race delivers something governments cannot restrain. We must organize now to prevent the loss of human control, rather than leave future generations to live with its consequences.
